'''Liang Junwu''' ({{zh|s=梁骏吾}}; 18 September 1933 – 23 June 2022) was a Chinese scientist in the field of [[Semiconductor|semiconductor materials]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He is known as the founder of early [[Semiconductor|semiconductor silicon materials]] in China.<ref name="duck">{{cite news|author1=Jie Mian ({{lang|zh|界面}})|url=https://k.sina.com.cn/article_6192937794_17120bb4202001uyiv.html#/ |script-title=zh:我国早期半导体硅材料奠基人梁骏吾院士因病逝世 |work=sina |date=24 June 2022 |access-date=26 June 2022 |language=zh}}</ref> He was a member of the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP).<ref name="duck"/>

==Biography==
Liang was born in [[Wuhan|Hankou]] (now Wuhan), [[Hubei]], on 18 September 1933. In 1951, he entered [[Wuhan University]], majoring in [[physics]]. In 1956, he was sent to study in the [[Soviet Union]] on government scholarships, earning his vice-doctorate degree from the Baykov Institute of Metallurgy, [[Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union]] in 1960.

Liang returned to China in 1960 and that same year became assistant research fellow at the Institute of Semiconductors, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He was assistant research fellow at the [[Yichang]] Semiconductor Factory in 1970, and held that office until 1979. In 1978, he was promoted to become research fellow at the Institute of Semiconductors, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

On 23 June 2022, he died from an illness in [[Beijing]], at the age of 88.<ref name="cat">{{cite news|author1=Wei Jiaming ({{lang|zh|卫佳明}})|url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_18719723 |script-title=zh:半导体材料专家梁骏吾院士逝世 |work=thepaper |date=24 June 2022 |access-date=26 June 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Liang married Wen Ruimei, who is also a research fellow at the Institute of Semiconductors, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news|author1=Hao Jun ({{lang|zh|郝俊}})|url=https://www.cae.cn/cae/html/main/col36/2014-05/15/20140515162048055953462_1.html |script-title=zh:梁骏吾：做真正的有用之"材" |work=cae.cn |date=15 May 2014 |access-date=26 June 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Contributions==
In the 1960s, Liang solved the key technology of high-purity zone melting [[silicon]]; In 1964, he prepared GaAs liquid phase epitaxial materials for room temperature lasers; In 1979, he successfully developed high-quality silicon zone melting single crystal without dislocation, vortex, low micro defect, low carbon and controllable oxygen for large-scale integrated circuits; In the 1980s, he initiated nitrogen doped neutron transmutation silicon single crystal, which solved the problem of silicon wafer integrity and uniformity; In early 1990s, he studied the growth of [[superlattice]] [[quantum well]] materials by [[metalorganic vapour-phase epitaxy]], and promoted the Chinese superlattice quantum well materials to a practical level in terms of crystal integrity, electrical properties and superlattice structure control; He also played an important role in the research and industrialization of [[polycrystalline silicon]] for solar cells.<ref name="cat"/>

==Honours and awards==
* 1996 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Third Class) for new methods and equipment for treatment and detection of [[arsenic]] in the environment.
* 1997 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] (CAE)
